name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 7 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-12-05, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
